brief.headline: Cut our measuring-cup price from ₹0.38 to ₹0.35/piece (match Premier Plastic) and shorten payment to 30 days to free up ₹10.19 L cash for us.

priceAsk.summary: Drop the measuring-cup price to ₹0.35/NOS, matching Premier Plastic.
priceAsk.basis: Premier Plastic sells the same cup at ₹0.35/NOS — an 8.6% gap. The market for similar PP caps trades at ₹0.55–1.20/pc with a verdict of MARKET-FAIR and headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume, so our ₹0.35 target sits well below that band and is entirely reasonable.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Move payment from 45 days after receipt to 30 days after receipt.

brief.financialLeverage: Mars Plastics publishes no financials, so we can't see their cash position or how much we matter to their revenue. That means we lean on our own data: we spend ₹1.24 Cr a year with them, and Premier Plastic already delivers the same cup 8.6% cheaper. We also have five strong alternates lined up — Manjushree (₹2569.83 Cr revenue, health B) and Mold-Tek (₹946.50 Cr, health B) are both bigger, healthier firms. With no financial window into Mars, the safe play is to push firmly on price (we have a clear benchmark) and payment terms (we carry the cash risk for 45 days), while quietly qualifying a second source in parallel.

evidence.point: Premier Plastic sells the measuring cup for ₹0.35/NOS
We pay Mars ₹0.38/NOS today — an 8.6% gap
Closing that gap saves us ₹82500 a year
Cutting payment terms from 45 to 30 days frees up ₹10.19 L cash for us
The market verdict for similar PP caps is MARKET-FAIR with headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume
evidence.figure: ₹0.55–1.20/pc ask band, typical ₹0.85–0.95/pc, verdict MARKET-FAIR; modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80

evidence.point: We spend ₹1.24 Cr annually with Mars — enough volume to matter

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter at ₹2569.83 Cr revenue, health B (65/100) — pharma bottles, caps, preforms; top second-source candidate

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader (₹946.50 Cr revenue, health B 73/100) — pails, containers, pharma; strong and profitable alternate for bottles and closures

alternates.name: Reliance Industries Limited (lead to qualify)
alternates.why: A manufacturer lead from market research (India-Pan, medium confidence) — verify capability and pricing before RFQ

risks: Mars publishes no financials, so we fly blind on their cash health and can't judge how hard to push without tipping them over — keep the tone firm but not aggressive.
We have no second source qualified yet — if Mars walks, we scramble; start auditing Manjushree or Mold-Tek now so we have a live backup by next quarter.
Premier Plastic's ₹0.35 price is our only benchmark for the measuring cup — confirm their volume, lead time and quality match ours before we anchor the entire ask on that number.
The market backup leads (Reliance, Srichakra, IVL Dhunseri, Dalmia, Ganesha, Chemco) are unqualified research hits — treat each as a lead to verify, not an approved alternate.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to close the 8.6% gap on the measuring cup — Premier delivers the same part at ₹0.35, and we'd like Mars to match that price and move to 30-day payment so we can keep growing this ₹1.24 Cr relationship together.
